experience.title: The Philosophy of WaU
experience.paragraph1: In a world tired of advertising and faceless brands, we developed a new marketing model—mythodesign WaU.
experience.paragraph2: It synthesizes visual art, cultural codes, and archetypes to create deep emotional bonds between product and person.
experience.paragraph3: WaU works with images and meanings.

list.item1: a combination of Japanese and Ukrainian traditions in modern symbolic design
list.item2: a strategy where each product is a cultural message
list.item3: a brand that speaks the language of depth, not superficial advertising
list.item4: a new aesthetics for a new era—where beauty, meaning, and authenticity serve as marketing tools

experience.paragraph4: Mythodesign WaU is when your brand has a soul—and this soul unites continents.
experience.paragraph5: Mythodesign of two cultures. Food and art in dialogue.
experience.paragraph6: Mythodesign of taste and meaning. Each product is part of a legend and scientific achievements.

products.title: WAU FOOD
products.quote: INTERIOR DESIGN IS AS MUCH ABOUT WHAT YOU DON'T PUT INSIDE A SPACE AS WHAT YOU PUT IN.
products.furnitureDescription: Working with furniture focused on clean lines and contextual design. Exploration of negative space, form, and function. Using natural wood, steel, and textiles to craft pieces that stand the test of time and evoke tranquility in spaces.
